about.title: 1. About DOQYN
about.p1: DOQYN is a document intelligence platform for companies and individual users, with features for organizing, analyzing, governing and auditing documents.
about.p2: By using DOQYN, you agree to these Terms and Conditions of Use in the version in force at the time of registration or of the access request.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility and user responsibility
eligibility.p1: You declare that you have the legal capacity to accept these terms and to provide true, complete and up-to-date information.
eligibility.p2: It is your responsibility to keep your contact details correct and to protect your access credentials.

company-access.title: 3. Company registration and access requests
company-access.p1: Companies may be registered by authorized administrators. Users requesting access to an existing company depend on administrative approval.
company-access.p2: Incorrect or incomplete information may delay or prevent access from being granted.

individual.title: 4. Individual use
individual.p1: Individual users may create individual access to manage personal documents in accordance with the platform's rules.
individual.p2: Use must respect the applicable law and the permissions granted within the workspace.

documents.title: 5. Uploading, analyzing and storing documents
documents.p1: Documents uploaded to the platform may be processed, classified, versioned and made available according to the permissions defined for your account or organization.
documents.p2: You are responsible for the content you upload and for the authorization to process it on the platform.

ai.title: 6. Use of artificial intelligence features
ai.p1: DOQYN may use automated and artificial intelligence features to support the analysis, classification and extraction of document information.
ai.p2: Automated results should be reviewed where necessary. They do not replace specialized human analysis in every case.

governance.title: 7. Permissions, groups and document governance
governance.p1: Access to documents, groups and features is controlled by roles, permissions and policies defined by the organization's administrators.
governance.p2: Access changes may be audited for operational and compliance purposes.

responsibility.title: 8. Responsibility for uploaded documents
responsibility.p1: You warrant that you have the right or the authorization to upload, share and process the documents made available in DOQYN.
responsibility.p2: Using the platform for unlawful or fraudulent content, or content that infringes third-party rights, is prohibited.

security.title: 9. Account security
security.p1: Keep your password confidential and notify the organization or support if you suspect misuse.
security.p2: Security measures are adopted proportionately, with no guarantee of absolute protection against every risk.

limitations.title: 10. Limitations on use
limitations.p1: It is forbidden to attempt to bypass access controls, exploit vulnerabilities, overload the platform, or use it outside its intended purposes.
limitations.p2: DOQYN may impose reasonable operational limits to preserve stability and security.

suspension.title: 11. Suspension or blocking of access
suspension.p1: Access may be suspended or blocked in the event of a breach of these terms, a security risk, a legal requirement, or an administrative decision by the organization.
suspension.p2: Relevant records may be retained for auditing in accordance with the applicable policy.

audit.title: 12. Auditing and operational records
audit.p1: Relevant events involving registration, access requests, approvals, changes and critical operations may be recorded for traceability.
audit.p2: These records are intended to support governance, support and operational compliance.

changes.title: 13. Changes to the terms
changes.p1: These terms may be updated. When a new version is issued, acceptance may be requested again during registration, access or use of the platform.
changes.p2: The version accepted and the date of acceptance may be recorded for auditing purposes.

contact.title: 14. Contact
contact.p1: For questions about these terms or about using the platform, use the official support or contact channels provided by your organization or by DOQYN.
